whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: New migration 20261020_0019 (AFC-544, parent AFC-515 BUILD decision): ALTER TABLE weca_returns ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submitted_by uuid + confirmed_by uuid (bare uuids, nullable -- no backfill, a guessed actor is a fabricated trail), COMMENT ON COLUMN for both, GRANT UPDATE (submitted_by, confirmed_by) ON weca_returns TO directus_app (the same ceiling branch_financial_records already states; computed lines stay grant-withheld, formulas untouched). Bootstrap-role DO block (fail closed, ADR-0002); rerunnable (all IF NOT EXISTS / idempotent GRANT/REVOKE); no role minting. Down script refuses with restrict_violation while any return carries a non-null actor, else REVOKEs the column grants and DROPs both columns (IF EXISTS). Suite 68 section 68.8 pins: columns exist nullable; fresh return names no actor; app can stamp submitted_by on submit and confirmed_by on confirm; app still cannot hand-edit computed_mf (42501, no widening); bogus computation_status refused (23514). No finance_events table invented (deferred slice). Actor id comes from the server session in the route, never the client body.
